_note: v2.7 plan 39 (NOT YET RUN; row 37-D3, the S-15 host half): an agenda paced every 2 in-fiction boundaries. Its first step carries a scripted npc_replies line (narrator) and its second a world_info enable on the run's own test book 'SO-V27-37D3 Lore' (created here through applyProvisioning, removed at the end by the assets verb; the runner's residue sweep also catches SO- books). No model call: every boundary is a /sendas line. Asserts: the NPC line posts exactly once when step 1 lands and a swipe of that reply rewinds its fire marker (npcReplyRewind: a swipe of the reply line itself); the entry is off before step 2, on after the boundary that landed it, and off again after deleting that reply; landed again, it is off after a swipe of that reply; no agenda world_info effect is ever ledgered: the entry rides the path replay (earnedWorldInfo), so its on/off state after each cut is the assertion (plan 36 §Gate: world info is never ledgered). Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-37-agenda-effect.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; return true;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error('the sandbox chat still holds ' + ctx.chat.length + ' message(s)'); return { cleared: true };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const book = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'createStoryLorebook', name: 'SO-V27-37D3 Lore' }, { requirements: { lorebooks: [] } }); if (!book.ok && !book.message.includes('already exists')) throw new Error('could not create the test lorebook: ' + book.message); const entry = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'upsertLorebookEntry', lorebook: 'SO-V27-37D3 Lore', comment: 'SO-D3 smuggler paid', keys: ['smuggler'], content: 'The smuggler has been paid in full.', constant: true }, { requirements: { lorebooks: ['SO-V27-37D3 Lore'] } }); if (!entry.ok) throw new Error('could not write the test entry: ' + entry.message); return { book: book.ok, entry: entry.ok };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); if (!rt.getSnapshot().requirements?.ready) throw new Error('requirements not ready: ' + JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().requirements)); const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error('timed out after ' + ms + ' ms: ' + what); await pause(200); } }; const entry = async () => { const book = await (await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'SO-V27-37D3 Lore' }), cache: 'no-cache' })).json(); const found = Object.values(book?.entries ?? {}).find((row) => row.comment === 'SO-D3 smuggler paid'); if (!found) throw new Error('the test entry is missing from the book'); return found; }; const step = () => Number(rt.getEngineState()?.blackboard.values.agenda_arin_debt_step ?? 0); const settle = async () => { await until(() => rt.getEngineState()?.lastMessageId === SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length - 1, 15000, 'the newest message to commit a boundary'); await pause(400); }; const land = async (target) => { for (let i = 0; i < 5 && step() < target; i += 1) { await SillyTavern.getContext().executeSlashCommandsWithOptions('/sendas name=Arin SO-D3 filler line ' + i + '.'); await settle(); } if (step() < target) throw new Error('agenda step ' + target + ' never landed: step=' + step() + ' values=' + JSON.stringify(rt.getEngineState().blackboard.values)); return rt.getEngineState().lastMessageId; }; const npcLines = () => SillyTavern.getContext().chat.filter((message) => String(message.mes ?? '').includes('SO-D3-NPC-LINE')).length; const agendaFires = () => Object.entries(rt.extras.firedNpcReplies ?? {}).filter(([key]) => key.startsWith('agenda:')); const agendaRows = () => (rt.getSnapshot().effects?.ledger ?? []).filter((row) => row.effect === 'world_info' && row.origin?.kind === 'agenda'); const multiSwipe = async () => { const live = SillyTavern.getContext(); const last = live.chat.length - 1; const reply = live.chat[last]; if (!reply || reply.is_user) throw new Error('the last message is not a reply'); reply.swipes = [reply.mes, 'SO-D3 alternative line.']; reply.swipe_id = 0; reply.swipe_info = [{}, {}]; await live.saveChat(); return last; }; globalThis.__d3 = { pause, until, entry, step, settle, land, npcLines, agendaFires, agendaRows, multiSwipe }; await until(async () => (await entry()).disable === true, 10000, 'the gated entry to start disabled'); return { step: step() };

const d3 = globalThis.__d3; await d3.settle(); const landedAt = await d3.land(1); await d3.until(() => d3.npcLines() > 0, 15000, 'the agenda NPC line to post'); await d3.settle(); await d3.pause(1500); if (d3.npcLines() !== 1) throw new Error('the agenda NPC line posted ' + d3.npcLines() + ' times'); const fires = d3.agendaFires(); if (fires.length !== 1 || fires[0][1] !== 1) throw new Error('agenda fire markers: ' + JSON.stringify(fires)); if ((await d3.entry()).disable !== true) throw new Error('the step-two entry is on before step two landed'); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (!String(ctx.chat.at(-1)?.mes ?? '').includes('SO-D3-NPC-LINE')) throw new Error('the NPC line is not the last message: ' + ctx.chat.at(-1)?.mes); return { landedAt, step: d3.step(), fires };

const d3 = globalThis.__d3; await d3.until(() => d3.agendaFires().length === 0, 10000, 'the swipe to rewind the agenda NPC marker'); await d3.pause(1500); if (d3.step() !== 1) throw new Error('swiping the NPC reply moved the agenda: step=' + d3.step()); const reposted = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.filter((message) => String(message.mes ?? '').includes('SO-D3-NPC-LINE')).length; if (reposted) throw new Error('the NPC line was posted again after the swipe: ' + reposted); return { fires: d3.agendaFires(), step: d3.step() };

const d3 = globalThis.__d3; const landedAt = await d3.land(2); await d3.until(async () => (await d3.entry()).disable === false, 15000, 'the step-two entry to switch on'); const rows = d3.agendaRows().filter((row) => row.messageId >= landedAt && row.status === 'applied'); if (d3.agendaRows().length) throw new Error('an agenda world_info effect was ledgered (plan 36: world info is never ledgered, it rides the path replay): ' + JSON.stringify(d3.agendaRows())); globalThis.__d3.landedAt = landedAt; if (landedAt !== SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length - 1) throw new Error('the landing reply is not the last message'); return { landedAt, rows: rows.length };

const d3 = globalThis.__d3; await d3.until(async () => (await d3.entry()).disable === true, 15000, 'the entry to switch off after deleting the landing reply'); if (d3.step() !== 1) throw new Error('the delete did not rewind the agenda: step=' + d3.step()); const after = d3.agendaRows().filter((row) => row.messageId >= d3.landedAt); if (after.length) throw new Error('an agenda world_info effect was ledgered (plan 36: world info is never ledgered, it rides the path replay): ' + JSON.stringify(after)); return { step: d3.step(), rows: after.map((row) => row.status) };

const d3 = globalThis.__d3; const landedAt = await d3.land(2); await d3.until(async () => (await d3.entry()).disable === false, 15000, 'the entry to switch on again'); if (d3.npcLines() !== 0) throw new Error('step two re-posted the step-one NPC line'); globalThis.__d3.landedAt = landedAt; return { landedAt, swipeable: await d3.multiSwipe() };

const d3 = globalThis.__d3; await d3.until(async () => (await d3.entry()).disable === true, 15000, 'the entry to switch off after swiping the landing reply'); if (d3.step() !== 1) throw new Error('the swipe did not rewind the agenda: step=' + d3.step()); const after = d3.agendaRows().filter((row) => row.messageId >= d3.landedAt); if (after.length) throw new Error('an agenda world_info effect was ledgered (plan 36: world info is never ledgered, it rides the path replay): ' + JSON.stringify(after)); return { step: d3.step() };
